purpose: Append-only evidence schema for reconstructing Second Shift lane state and useful execution without inferring utilization from commits, runner uptime or workflow duration.
storage_rule: Use one lane-owned ledger per shift date to avoid cross-lane append conflicts: governance/second-shift/execution-events/YYYY-MM-DD/{CORE|LEARNING|BOOK|PROSE}.json
claim_lifecycle_rules: CLAIMED opens exactly one mutation-capable lease for the lane; a second live claim is invalid.
RUNNING and PROGRESS require a live preceding CLAIMED lease for the same delegation, control head and idempotency key.
HEARTBEAT must refer to the live lease and preserve the same idempotency key while advancing a durable checkpoint pointer.
COMPLETED, BLOCKED or STALE releases the live lease for that delegation; successor work requires a new claim after live-owner revalidation.
SHIFT_CLOSE is invalid while a mutation-capable lease remains unresolved.
event_order_rules: event_id values are unique within a lane ledger.
occurred_at values are monotonic nondecreasing within the append-only ledger.
Every current-state event uses the exact live owner control_ref and control_head observed for that event.
IDLE_VALID requires a preceding same-head ALL_RUNGS_EXHAUSTED event containing exactly eight rung dispositions and independent_work_remaining=false.
retry_rules: retry_budget must be an integer from 1 through max_retry_budget.
After the retry budget is consumed, the dependency becomes CIRCUIT_OPEN for that invocation and the lane switches to a dependency-valid fallback rung when one exists.
Repeated transient failure never proves whole-lane exhaustion.
utilization_rules: State-duration calculations use occurred_at event boundaries only.
RUNNING means an owner-valid worker has a live claim and is performing or awaiting a bounded operation that is part of the current objective; runner uptime alone is not RUNNING.
READY means executable dependency-valid work exists but is not presently claimed.
BLOCKED applies only to the objective/rung actually blocked; it cannot be promoted to whole-lane idle while another rung is executable.
IDLE_VALID requires a preceding ALL_RUNGS_EXHAUSTED event for the same live owner head and shift.
If telemetry is missing, stale or contradictory, the audit reports UNKNOWN rather than inferring productive time.
authority_boundary: This ledger records execution state only. It never grants PASS, promotion, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, blind, native, publication or production authority.
